artifacts.summary: Revised 5-phase plan for Modal upstream PR, accounting for PR #647 closure, with Zulip coordination before submission

memory_candidates.content: When a prerequisite PR is closed without merge (PR #647 pattern), upstream PR plans must include a Phase 1 decision gate that determines branching strategy before any code work. Options: (1) re-submit prerequisite, (2) bundle prerequisite content, (3) defer dependent features. Community coordination (Zulip) should precede PR submission when there is an active conflicting PR with a different design approach, not follow it.
